tbesh_html:
1) the holy of holies, the innermost room of the temple or tabernacle
1a) hindmost chamber, innermost room of the temple of Solomon, most holy place, holy of holies
2) (TWOT) oracle

strongs_1890.strongs_def: the shrine or innermost part of the sanctuary
strongs_1890.derivation: or (shortened) דְּבִר; from H1696 (דָבַר) (apparently in the sense of oracle);
